text:
"Evening ramp crew," on its own line, then a line break, and then "Waiting areas came up after lunch, so just a quick note"

Hello team,

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk notes current as you work through the evening handoff. When a traveler reaches the desk with a pet, log the basics clearly, keep the tone steady, and pass along only the facts that matter for the next shift. If a case feels unclear, do not rush it along. Take a calm stepwise look, check the travel file, and bring in the senior coordinator only after the first review is done.

For shared trips and connection changes, make sure the handoff note says what the traveler was told and what still needs a follow-up. If you are dealing with a delay, keep the language plain and avoid promises that have not been checked. The service works best when every note shows the same careful approach, because each journey is a shared responsibility. If Rosie or any other pet is mentioned in conversation, add the detail exactly as given and keep personal comments out of the record.

Please also watch the waiting areas for any small change that affects comfort or flow, and note it in the log if it changes how we support the traveler. Clean records help the next person step in without repeating work, and they also make it easier to resolve escalations in order. Thanks for keeping Aurelia Skyways steady and calm for everyone moving through the desk.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
